description: This file defines the PasswordStrengthService class, which provides password policy enforcement, validation, and reset functionalities within the OrangeHRM system. It manages password strength criteria, validation messages, and reset request handling.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class responsible for enforcing password policies, validating passwords, generating reset codes, and managing password reset requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Returns the data access object for enforced password requests, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum password length configured in the system settings.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum allowed password length.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of lowercase letters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of uppercase letters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of numeric characters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of special characters required in a password.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Indicates whether spaces are allowed in passwords based on configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Returns the default password strength setting from configuration.

methods.name: checkMinPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMaxPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password exceeds the maximum length limit.

methods.name: checkMinLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Validates if the password contains at least the minimum required lowercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Validates if the password contains at least the minimum required uppercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinNumbersInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum required numbers.

methods.name: checkMinSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of special characters.

methods.name: checkSpacesInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains spaces when they are not allowed.

methods.name: checkRequiredDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Ensures the password meets the minimum strength criteria based on system default levels.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates the password against all enforced policies and returns corresponding messages.

methods.name: isValidPassword
methods.description: Determines if the password complies with all rules and default strength level.

methods.name: generateEnforcePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a secure, encoded reset code for password enforcement.

methods.name: logPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Logs a password enforcement request and returns the reset code.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates a password reset URL code for expiration and usage status.

methods.name: isResetCodeTimeOut
methods.description: Checks if the reset code has expired based on time elapsed.

methods.name: getUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Returns the username associated with a specific reset code.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates if the user exists and is not terminated.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Saves a new enforced password for a user after transaction management, returning success status.
